question: Can unbounded prepared-owner profiles predict the finite retention knee under a previously unevaluated backing-memory service schedule?
smoke_scope: one instrumentation-dummy run for the changed memory-service and tracing path; excluded from public evidence
profiling: K=infinity only, full 19-workload suite in both E arms; no finite alternate-memory outcome may be read before numeric prediction freeze

primary_prediction.unit: incremental fast consumes relative to age 1
primary_prediction.rule: O_E(K)=sum unbounded fast-consume counts with 1<age<=K; K_star=min integer K>=2 such that O_E(K)>=0.99*O_E(infinity); if O=0 choose K_star=1 and mark no opportunity

cycle_prediction.rule: w_j=1 if id_fire is true at an unbounded delayed fast consume, else 0; S_hat_E(K)=sum w_j for 1<age_j<=K; choose smallest K capturing 99% of S_hat(infinity)
cycle_prediction.independent_justification: RTL immediate-product path departs EX on the request edge; ordinary low MUL reaches PRODUCT and departs one edge later. An otherwise possible same-edge ID admission is blocked by this added EX edge. If id_fire is absent, the isolated added edge fills an existing admission gap. This local overlap approximation assumes later memory/fetch phase changes do not alter net benefit; that assumption is tested, never fitted to finite outcomes.
cycle_prediction.global_phase_assumption: local one-edge effects add independently; no residual is learned from K=1 or finite outcomes
cycle_prediction.null_comparator: unit weight for every delayed fast consume

validation_selection: After numeric freeze, evaluate K=1 and union of opportunity K_star-1/K_star, cycle K_star-1/K_star, and maximum unbounded delayed-consume age for each arm. Minimum integer is 1. Both E arms evaluate their own predeclared points, all 19 workloads.
validation_metrics: workload and aggregate opportunity count error
predicted vs measured absolute cycle savings
predicted vs measured 99% knee among registered bracketing points
same functional writeback digest excluding only the two exact start_trigger cycle-word load PCs at MMIO offsets 1040/1044
counterfactual_identity: Prepared owner admission IDs link event rows to absolute architectural retirement ordinal plus PC/expanded instruction; admission sequence alone is not used for cross-arm matching. Unretired/canceled owners retain frontier retirement counter and admission identity, separately.
failure_policy: Preserve all counterexamples and report unsuccessful prediction or owner correspondences; never modify the frozen rule after outcomes.
